title: Security
description: Manage password, two-factor authentication (2FA), and active sessions for your account.

2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
2fa.subtitle: Strengthen security with a TOTP code on every sign-in.
2fa.stepHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy...) then enter the 6-digit code to activate.
2fa.enabledHint: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication.
2fa.disableHint: Enter your current verification code to disable 2FA.
2fa.setupError: Could not generate the QR code. Please try again.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Update your sign-in password.
password.setPasswordDescription: Your account signs in with Google. Set a password so you can sign in directly.
password.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password.passwordNeedDigit: Password must contain at least 1 number.
password.changeFailed: Failed to change password. Check your current password.
password.useOtp: Forgot your current password? Change it with an OTP
password.otpHint: Send a confirmation code to your email, then enter the 6-digit code with your new password.
password.otpSent: A confirmation code was sent to your email
password.otpChangeFailed: Failed to change password. The code is wrong or expired.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.deactivateHint: Deactivating will lock your account. Data is not permanently deleted.
danger.confirmBody: You will not be able to sign in until reactivated. This can be undone by signing back in.
danger.otpSent: A confirmation code was sent to your email

session.title: Session & Sign out
session.subtitle: Manage your current active session on this device.
session.hint: Signing out will end your current session on this device and clear stored authentication credentials from your browser. You will need to sign in again to continue.
session.confirmBody: Are you sure you want to log out of your account?
session.confirmDetails: Your current active session on this device will end and you will be redirected to the sign-in page.

score.title: Security Score
score.subtitle: Account protection rating according to BrandHub standards
score.passwordDesc: Protect your account with a strong password
score.emailDesc: Receive sign-in alerts and recovery codes
score.oauthDesc: Quick and secure sign-in via Google

sessions.title: Devices & Active Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Manage devices currently signed in to your BrandHub account
sessions.revokeOthersConfirmTitle: Log out of all other devices?
sessions.revokeOthersConfirmBody: All sessions on other browsers and devices will be terminated immediately.
sessions.revokeOthersWarning: If you suspect unauthorized access, please change your password immediately after logging out.
sessions.revokeOthersSuccess: Successfully logged out of all other devices
sessions.revokeOthersError: Could not log out of other devices. Please try again.

tips.title: Security Recommendations
tips.subtitle: Best practices to protect your account and brand assets
tips.tip1Desc: Block over 99% of account takeover attempts with TOTP authenticator codes.
tips.tip2Desc: Do not reuse your BrandHub password for any other online accounts or services.
tips.tip3Desc: Never share your OTP or recovery codes with anyone, including BrandHub staff.
